neitherFound.desc: X-Launcher will use GitHub Releases as a fallback, but installation may be slower. For optimal runner management, install at least one of the two:

plugins.intro: Enable or disable store plugins. Installed games stay visible even with the plugin disabled, but DRM titles won't be launchable.

input.genericFallbackNote: The Generic plugin is the fallback for unrecognized controllers and shouldn't be disabled.
input.testModeActive: Test mode active: the Dashboard ignores all input while you're here, so nothing else triggers by accident.
input.testInstructions: Press a button or move the sticks: the diagram lights up in real time with exactly what the Dashboard is reading from the controller.
input.connectControllerPrompt: Connect a controller to verify its inputs are detected correctly.
input.testModeHint: Test mode — hold B to exit

storePluginDescriptions.GOG_Galaxy: GOG Galaxy library — DRM-free, requires lgogdownloader
storePluginDescriptions.Classic_Console: Classic consoles and ROMs — RetroArch, DOSBox, ScummVM

inputPluginDescriptions.generic: Fallback for unrecognized controllers — standard XInput layout
inputPluginDescriptions.xinput: Xbox 360, Xbox One, Xbox Series and generic XInput controllers

aiAdvisor.experimentalNote: The AI Advisor is in testing — responses may need manual debugging.
aiAdvisor.modelsIntro: Ollama models already downloaded on this machine. Pick which one to use for the AI Advisor when the local Knowledge Base doesn't find a known solution — smaller models respond faster and put less load on the GPU shared with games, larger models can give more accurate answers.
aiAdvisor.noModelsFound: No model found — download one from the terminal with 'ollama pull <name>'.

cloudProviderNotes.gemini: Real free tier with rate limits. On this tier, prompts and responses may be used by Google to improve its models — for sensitive data, use the paid tier.
cloudProviderNotes.deepseek: 5 million free tokens on signup, no credit card required.
cloudProviderNotes.chatgpt: Requires a prepaid top-up (min. $5) on platform.openai.com — no real free tier, even for the cheapest models.
cloudProviderNotes.claude: Pay-as-you-go from the very first use on console.anthropic.com — no real free tier.
